target: acceptances 1-3 — the runner must print a message distinguishing 'nothing ran' from a pass, and name the argument that matched nothing. Exit codes alone were asserted; the message was not.
cmd:
mkdir -p c/real; cat > c/real/r-1.json <<'CASEEOF'
{"id": "r-1", "target": "synthetic", "kind": "bash-unit", "cmd": "echo '{}'", "checks": [{"type": "exit_code", "equals": 0}]}
CASEEOF
a=$(EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite ghostsuite 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -c "ghostsuite"); b=$(EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --case ghostcase 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -c "ghostcase"); n=$(EVAL_CASES_DIR="$PWD/c" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/evals/run_eval.sh" --suite ghostsuite 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -ci "nothing ran"); printf '{"names_suite":%s,"names_case":%s,"says_nothing_ran":%s}' "$a" "$b" "$n"

provenance.note: spec 004 revision 1 — message content had no coverage
